slides.texte_overlay:
the routine that fixed my
messy life
(save and try)
7:00 wake up at the same time every day, weekends included. A fixed wake-up time fixes your sleep, your energy and your mood within two weeks.
7:15 make your bed and open the windows. Fresh air and one finished task before breakfast set the tone for an organised day. Eat slowly and enjoy it.
12:30 eat lunch away from your desk. Fifteen minutes without screens resets your head for the afternoon. Outside if you can, even in winter, with good shoes and a warm jacket.
18:00 train or walk for 45 minutes. Moving after work clears the stress of the day and makes your evening much calmer. Movement is non-negotiable.
20:00 learn something. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it replaced an hour of mindless scrolling. Small daily lessons add up.
slides.texte_sophia: 20:00 I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It replaced an hour of mindless scrolling.

slides.texte_overlay: 21:00 ten-minute reset. Dishes done, clothes away, desk clear. Waking up to a tidy home makes the next day start right. It takes five minutes.
22:30 lights out. Book instead of phone. A calm end to the day is what makes the whole routine work. Keep it simple, do it for two weeks, and adjust what doesn't fit your life.
